verdict.rationale: Supabase's Management API (docs-28) and CLI (docs-5/32) allow programmatic creation/management of projects, and branching (docs-26/36) supports isolated per-PR preview environments, which partially supports the 'isolated environment per tenant/agent' idea. However, there is no evidence Supabase is designed or priced for spinning up thousands of lightweight per-agent/tenant databases cheaply — projects are the unit of isolation and typically incur real cost/quota limits, and no docs address fleet-scale bulk provisioning or cost efficiency at that scale. Missing for 10: evidence of thousands-scale project/database creation, pricing/cost model for high-volume ephemeral DBs, and fleet-management tooling beyond branching/API for individual projects.
